items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: me and Hank Mobley tryin' to get down here, you know, from Penn Station.

ctx.x: Um, uh, since we kind of mentioned Baltimore, um, do you remember the Left Bank Jazz Society?

Yes. Oh yeah, couldn't, how could I forget them? Yeah. That was a major … and uh, the, the, the, the, the uh, the uh funny thing uh one of the funny things was uh, me and Hank Mobley tryin' to get down here, you know, from Penn Station. There was one train and if you missed that one, you definitely would be late. And we had uh, we actually had our hands, if you can picture, we were, the train was pullin' out, we had our hands on the train but couldn't get on it, man. It broke, both are hearts were broken, layin'…
I thought that was one of the best listening experiences …
